title: Geometric products and multivectors
幾何積及多重向量
intro: Change lengths, reverse the order, and separate the grades. Build a usable geometric language from four small experiments.
改變長度、交換順序、拆開階數。用四個小實驗，把幾何積變成能操作、能檢查的語言。

title: What survives when arrows multiply?
兩支箭頭相乘，留下什麼？
Same area, opposite orientation
面積一樣，定向相反
summary: Why does swapping two arrows reverse their wedge product?
為什麼交換兩支箭頭，外積的符號會反轉？
visual: Swap the edges of the same parallelogram and reverse its orientation marker.
交換同一平行四邊形的兩條邊，觀察定向標記反轉。

title: Geometry of arranging storage boxes
從收納箱的擺法認識多重向量
Complex numbers, quaternions and tensors
複數、四元數與張量的關係
The algebra toolkit
代數工具箱
intro: What changes when we change the multiplication rules? Try metrics, grade selection, reversing and duality, then compare two descriptions of the same rotation.
換一套乘法規則，結果會怎樣？從度規、階數篩選、反轉與對偶，走到同一個旋轉的兩種描述。

title: Choose a metric signature
先選度規符號
summary: How do positive, negative and null basis squares change the multiplication rules?
基底平方為正、負或零，會怎樣改變乘法規則？
visual: Compare three two-direction multiplication tables with positive, negative and zero basis squares.
比較三套兩方向的乘法表，看看正、負、零平方如何改變結果。

title: Read the grades of a product
從乘積讀出各階成分
summary: Distinguish geometric, inner and outer products, including which grades survive.
分清幾何積、內積與外積，以及各自留下哪些階數。
visual: Sort coloured product terms into scalar, vector, bivector and higher-grade bins.
把不同顏色的乘積項分類到純量、向量、雙向量與更高階。

title: Reverse is not always inverse
反轉不一定是反元素
summary: When can reversing a product undo a transformation, and when is normalization needed?
什麼時候反轉乘積就能撤銷變換，什麼時候還要正規化？
visual: Reverse a chain of factors and compare its product with the identity.
把因子順序倒過來，檢查乘回去是否得到單位元素。

title: Duality, complements and cross products
對偶、補空間與叉積
summary: Relate the three-dimensional cross product to oriented planes without assuming every pseudoscalar is invertible.
把三維叉積連回定向平面，並分清偽純量不可逆時的情況。
visual: A plane-to-normal view alongside a degenerate-model exception.
對照平面與法向量，另標出退化模型需要不同處理。

title: Where tensors still belong
張量仍然負責什麼
summary: Compare a multivector, a linear map on multivectors, and a tensor product of state spaces.
比較多重向量、作用於多重向量的線性映射，以及狀態空間的張量積。
visual: Show the same rotation as a rotor sandwich and as a matrix acting on coefficients.
把同一旋轉並排畫成轉子夾乘與作用在分量上的矩陣。

title: Rotors & spinors
轉子與旋量
intro: Build rotations from reflections and distinguish rotating an arrow from transforming a spinor.
從反射建立旋轉，分清箭頭與旋量的變換方式。

title: Two reflections make a rotation
兩次反射拼成旋轉
summary: Why does the angle between two mirrors produce twice that rotation angle?
為什麼兩面鏡子的夾角，會產生兩倍角度的旋轉？
visual: An arrow reflected successively in two adjustable mirrors.
一支箭頭依序經過兩面可調角度的鏡子。

title: Rotate in a plane, not just around an axis
在平面中旋轉，不只繞軸想像
Why a spinor remembers a full turn
旋量為什麼記得轉過一圈
Rotation order matters
旋轉順序有差別
summary: Why can two rotations in different planes produce different answers when swapped?
為什麼不同平面的兩次旋轉，交換順序後可能得到不同答案？
visual: Compare two ordered rotations of the same marked object.
把同一個帶標記物件依兩種順序旋轉並排比較。

title: Geometric models
幾何模型
intro: Choose a representation for directions, rigid motions, or circles and spheres.
依方向、剛體運動或圓與球的需求，選擇表示方式。

title: Rigid motion: projective geometric algebra
剛體運動：射影幾何代數
Points, lines and planes in PGA
PGA 中的點、線與面
summary: How do incidence, joining and intersecting objects work in a chosen PGA convention?
在選定的 PGA 慣例裡，如何表示相接、連接與相交？
visual: Move two lines and watch their intersection, including a parallel limit.
移動兩條直線並追蹤交點，包含接近平行的極限。

title: Conformal Geometric Algebra (CGA): circles and spheres
共形幾何代數（CGA）：圓與球
summary: Why embed ordinary points in a larger space to manipulate circles and spheres?
為什麼把普通點嵌入更大的空間，反而能方便處理圓與球？
visual: A point, circle and sphere transformed together in a conformal-model sketch.
在共形模型示意圖裡，同時變換點、圓與球。

title: Choose the smallest useful model
選擇夠用的模型
summary: Compare Euclidean GA, PGA, CGA and spacetime algebra by task, signature and storage.
依任務、符號與儲存量，比較歐氏 GA、PGA、CGA 與時空代數。
visual: A task-to-model comparison table with geometric examples.
用幾何例子配上任務與模型的比較表。

title: Spacetime & fields
時空與場
intro: Start with a flash on a train, detector dots, a pushed charge and flashlight light. Look at what happens before naming the state, field or spacetime algebra.
從火車上的閃光、量測器的點，到電荷受力與手電筒的光。先看發生什麼，再問怎麼記錄與計算。

title: How fields push a charge
電場與磁場怎麼推電荷
From a flashlight to a light wave
從手電筒走到光波
Calculus & connections
微積分與聯絡
intro: Extend pointwise algebra to changing fields and comparisons between nearby points.
把單點代數延伸到變動的場，以及相鄰位置的比較。

title: A derivative that keeps geometric parts
保留幾何成分的微分
summary: How can a vector derivative organize divergence and curl without losing their different roles?
向量微分如何整理散度與旋度，又保留兩者不同的角色？
visual: Sample a field around a small region and separate outflow from circulation.
在小區域周圍取樣，把向外流出與環繞流動分開。

title: Compare two transport routes
比較兩條平移路徑
summary: What does a mismatch after transport around a small loop tell us about curvature?
沿小迴路平移一圈後的差異，告訴我們什麼曲率資訊？
visual: Transport an arrow around a loop on a curved surface.
讓箭頭沿彎曲表面上的小迴路移動。

title: A boundary and its interior
邊界與內部的關係
summary: Connect geometric integration with familiar divergence and Stokes theorems.
把幾何積分連回熟悉的散度定理與斯托克斯定理。
visual: Compare accumulated interior contributions with an oriented boundary sum.
比較內部累積貢獻與帶方向的邊界總和。

title: Scope & open questions
適用範圍與開放問題
intro: Separate established algebra, physical interpretation and proposals that need evidence.
分清確立的代數、物理解讀，以及仍需要證據的提案。

title: A shared language is not every theory
共同語言不等於所有理論
summary: Which tasks need connections, topology, quantum state spaces or extra physical assumptions beyond a Clifford product?
哪些問題除了克利福德乘積，還需要聯絡、拓撲、量子狀態空間或額外物理假設？
visual: A map connecting each mathematical structure to the job it actually performs.
把各種數學結構連到它實際負責的工作。

title: CPT, chirality and the limits of geometric analogies
CPT、手徵性與幾何比喻的邊界
A map of ideas and their status
觀念地圖與證據狀態
Compact notation, real costs
記號精簡，成本仍在
summary: Why do shorter formulas not guarantee fewer coefficients, faster computation or a simpler physical model?
為什麼公式變短，不保證分量更少、計算更快，或物理模型更簡單？
visual: Compare symbolic expression length, coefficient count and measured work.
並排比較公式長度、分量數量與實際運算量。

title: Clifford history
克利福德代數史
intro: Two nineteenth-century ideas meet in one product. Follow the algebra into electron theory, spacetime, graphics and geometric learning. Dates mark selected publications and teaching milestones, not a single uninterrupted invention.
兩條十九世紀的思想在同一個乘積相遇,沿著代數走向電子理論、時空、圖學與幾何學習。

title: Hamilton: multiply rotations
哈密頓：讓旋轉可以相乘
Grassmann: let areas be objects
格拉斯曼：把面積當成物件
Clifford asks whether matter is geometry
克利福德問：物質能否來自幾何？
A metric product joins the picture
把度規帶進乘法
Dirac: algebra inside the electron equation
狄拉克：電子方程裡的代數
Hestenes builds spacetime algebra
赫斯特尼斯建立時空代數的教學路線
A textbook connects the physics tools
教材把物理工具連起來
Geometric algebra becomes inspectable code
讓幾何代數成為可檢查的程式
PGA: one language for rigid geometry
PGA：用共同語言處理剛體幾何
Geometry enters neural architectures
把幾何放進神經網路架構
Represent & multiply
表示與乘法
intro: Follow coefficients from a blade label through a geometric product.
從基底標記一路追蹤分量，直到算出幾何積。

title: Make conventions explicit
明確寫出實作慣例
summary: How do blade order, metric signature and coefficient layout affect interoperable code?
基底排序、度規符號與分量配置，會如何影響程式之間的相容性？
visual: Trace one blade pair through two layouts and an explicit conversion.
追蹤同一對基底在兩種配置中的位置，並顯示轉換。

title: Transformation code
變換程式
intro: Turn rotor formulas into reusable, inspectable transformations.
把轉子公式寫成可重用、可檢查的變換。

title: Compose without losing the order
組合變換，保留順序
summary: How can code compose and undo rotations while keeping frame conventions explicit?
程式如何組合與撤銷旋轉，並清楚標明參考座標的慣例？
visual: A read-only trace of two rotor products and the resulting arrow.
逐步顯示兩個轉子的乘法，以及產生的箭頭。

title: Interpolate a rotation safely
穩定地插值旋轉
summary: How should normalization, sign choices and near-identical orientations be handled?
正規化、符號選擇與幾乎相同的姿態，應如何處理？
visual: Compare interpolated orientations, rotor norms and endpoint checks.
比較插值姿態、轉子範數與端點檢查。

title: Geometry in code
幾何程式
intro: Make points, lines and rigid motions concrete with read-only examples.
用可閱讀的範例，把點、線與剛體運動變成具體操作。

title: Build a small PGA scene
建立小型 PGA 場景
summary: Encode two lines and inspect their intersection using one documented convention.
依明確記錄的慣例編碼兩條直線，並檢查交點。
visual: A diagram synchronized with line coefficients and an intersection trace.
讓直線圖、係數與交點計算步驟同步顯示。

title: Apply a rigid motion
套用剛體運動
summary: How does a motor move a point, a line and a whole object consistently?
同一個馬達如何一致地移動點、直線與整個物件？
visual: Move a marked triangle and its supporting lines with the same motor.
用同一個馬達移動帶標記三角形與它的邊線。

title: Work with a conformal point
處理共形點
summary: Show embedding, transformation and extraction, including scale conventions.
展示嵌入、變換與取回座標，包含尺度慣例。
visual: A read-only pipeline linking Euclidean coordinates to a conformal representation.
以唯讀流程圖連接歐氏座標與共形表示。

title: Test the geometry
檢查幾何是否正確
intro: Check identities and physical invariants before trusting a compact formula.
相信精簡公式之前，先檢查恆等式與物理不變量。

title: Test the algebraic promises
檢查代數承諾
summary: Which small tests catch incorrect signs, grade ordering and signature handling?
哪些小型檢查能抓出符號、階數排序與度規處理的錯誤？
visual: A failing blade product traced to its sign rule, then checked across signatures.
從失敗的基底乘積追到符號規則，再跨不同度規檢查。

title: Compare against a second representation
用另一種表示交叉檢查
summary: How can matrix and coordinate calculations check a rotor result independently?
如何用矩陣與座標計算，獨立檢查轉子結果？
visual: Overlay two computed rotations and display their numerical error.
疊合兩種方法算出的旋轉，顯示數值誤差。

title: Geometric learning & applications
幾何學習與應用
intro: Start with symmetry requirements, then ask what the evidence shows.
先定義對稱性需求，再問實驗證據支持什麼。

title: Geometric learning: what the evidence supports
幾何學習：證據支持到哪裡
Molecules and geometric features
分子與幾何特徵
summary: Which molecular quantities should stay invariant, and which should rotate with the input?
哪些分子量應保持不變，哪些輸出應隨輸入一起旋轉？
visual: Rotate the same molecule and compare scalar predictions with directional outputs.
轉動同一個分子，比較純量預測與帶方向的輸出。

title: Frames, robots and pose
座標框架、機器人與姿態
summary: How do frame conventions and rigid transformations enter a small kinematic chain?
座標框架的慣例與剛體變換，如何進入一個小型運動鏈？
visual: A two-link arm with local frames and a traced end-effector position.
兩節機械臂附上局部框架，並追蹤末端位置。

title: Storage & performance
儲存與效能
intro: Keep geometric meaning while measuring the actual computational cost.
保留幾何意義，同時量測實際計算成本。

title: Use the structure you know
利用已知的結構
summary: When can grade restrictions, sparsity or a fixed signature remove unnecessary work?
什麼時候可利用階數限制、稀疏性或固定度規，省下不必要的運算？
visual: Compare dense coefficient pairs with only the nonzero products needed by a rotor.
比較密集分量配對與轉子真正需要的非零乘積。

title: Batching and differentiation
批次運算與微分
summary: How should blade axes, batch axes and gradients be kept distinct?
如何分清基底軸、批次軸與梯度？
visual: Trace a batch of multivectors through a product and a gradient check.
追蹤一批多重向量通過乘積，再檢查梯度。

title: Measure a fair comparison
量測公平的比較
summary: Compare equivalent tasks, precision and accuracy, including conversion overhead.
比較相同任務、精度與準確度，並納入表示轉換的開銷。
visual: A benchmark plan with matched inputs, outputs and correctness checks.
以配對的輸入、輸出與正確性檢查，畫出量測流程。
